item.tib: dbal khyung dmar po'i bsrung ba mi 'jigs gur khang
item.coloph: drag po khyung gi cha lag bsrung (srung) ba mi 'gyur g.yung drung 'khyil pa'i gur khang 'di/ sgo rigs nyi ri khir shar bris/ de ltar ye shes khyung gi cha lag srung ba mi 'gyur g.yung drung 'khyil pa'i gur khang gi rgyud las kyang ma byung yang bon sgo bzhi dang bstun nas dgos rgyur mnyam par dang / gshen chen po tshe dbang bsod nams bstan rgyal dang*/ kun grol yang srid gsum pa bstan 'dzin rin chen gtsug phud rnams kyis/ mdzad pa'i kha bskang tsam byas na legs pa'i bka' phab du/ chu stag zla tshes la bris pa rgyal bstan 'gro ba'i dpal du rgyur gyur cig/
